description: This Java source file defines the class GatewayByRoundTripSignalEnrichmentProvider, which implements a provider for signal enrichment facades that perform a round-trip query mechanism within a gateway service. It creates and exposes a singleton facade instance, configured using an ActorSystem and a configuration object, and provides access to it via a getter method.

classes.name: GatewayByRoundTripSignalEnrichmentProvider
classes.description: A provider class for creating and exposing a singleton instance of ByRoundTripSignalEnrichmentFacade, configured for a gateway service scenario where each signal enrichment involves a round-trip communication.
